name: Flowchart
description: Boxes and arrows for processes, decisions and workflows.

name: Sequence diagram
description: Messages exchanged between participants over time.

name: Class diagram
description: Classes, attributes, methods and their relationships.

name: State diagram
description: States and the transitions between them.

name: Entity relationship
description: Database tables and how they relate.

name: User journey
description: Steps a user takes and how they feel at each one.

name: Gantt chart
description: Project schedule with tasks, durations and dependencies.

name: Pie chart
description: Proportions of a whole.

name: Quadrant chart
description: Plot items on two axes split into four quadrants.

name: Requirement diagram
description: Requirements and the elements that satisfy them.

name: Git graph
description: Commits, branches and merges.

name: C4 diagram
description: Software architecture at context, container and component level.

name: Mindmap
description: Ideas branching out from a central topic.

name: Timeline
description: Events in chronological order.

name: Sankey diagram
description: Flows between nodes, with width showing quantity.

name: XY chart
description: Bar and line charts on x and y axes.

name: Block diagram
description: Blocks laid out on a grid, for system overviews.

name: Packet diagram
description: Bit layout of a network packet or binary format.

name: Kanban board
description: Tasks in columns by status.

name: Architecture diagram
description: Services, groups and connections, with icons.

name: Radar chart
description: Compare items across several axes.

name: Treemap
description: Nested rectangles sized by value.

name: Venn diagram
description: Overlapping sets.

name: Ishikawa (fishbone)
description: Root-cause analysis of a problem.

name: Wardley map
description: Value chain against evolution.

name: Railroad diagram
description: Grammar rules drawn as syntax diagrams.

name: Tree view
description: A file or folder tree.

name: Cynefin
description: Sense-making framework with five domains.
